jobs.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years
, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million
people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About The Role

Responsible for conducting research and root cause analysis for customers with the goal of recommending and implementing new processes and solutions to operational deficiencies. Resolves issues and improves operational performance on a cross-functional/departmental basis. This is a senior level position working independently with guidance only in the most complex situations.

What You'll Do

Analyze regulatory materials, guidance, communications, and correspondence to understand assigned mandate and EOB requirements.
Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned mandates and partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Operations, IT, and business teams to interpret requirements.
Partner with the assigned Business Systems Analyst (BSA) to develop the Initiative Request Form (IRF) and project scope summary, ensuring mandate requirements, compliance considerations, and impacted business areas are accurately represented to support development of the High-Level Business Case (HLBC).
Ensure Compliance is engaged at the appropriate level (stakeholder, approver, etc.).
Translate business requirements and assist IT with the development of technical specifications.
Develop solutions based on data analysis to increase business efficiency.
Lead or participate in internal and external project workgroup(s) and presentations.
Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for projects, implementations, system fixes and enhancements, etc.
Prepare materials for internal and external audit activities; review audit findings/reports for accuracy and completeness. If appropriate, formulate rebuttal and/or corrective action steps.
May coach/mentor less experienced staff, assist in on-boarding of new staff and/or distribute and follow-up on work assignments.
Perform other relevant tasks as assigned by management.

Education/Experience

What You Bring

High School Diploma/GED required.
Bachelor degree preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree.
Minimum of seven (7) years' experience in an operational role, or analytical role.

Knowledge

Knowledge of Healthcare industry required.
Knowledge of Project Management methodologies.
May require knowledge of Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shields products and services.
May require working knowledge of division operating plan and Horizon operating model.

Travel

Some office travel required.

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

$87,300 - $119,070

The role of a Business Analyst is to act as an intermediary between the Data and Technology team and the business segments. This individual will partner with business stakeholders to identify and document their department’s technology needs to deliver new solutions, system improvements and create new features that are in sync with business strategies, goals and objectives. In addition, the Business Analyst will work alongside development and quality assurance teams during the enhancement and implementation phases to ensure that deliverables remain aligned to business needs. The Business Analyst is instrumental in fostering communication between the technical personnel and project stakeholders, ensuring alignment with our goals and meaningful project outcomes. The ideal candidate is someone who excels in a dynamic, fast-paced, agile setting, effectively handling multiple requests, at a variety of different stages at any given time.

Specific Responsibilities

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, document, and synthesize information into clear, actionable requirements
Understand strategic direction and ensure that current and new systems, solutions, features and functions satisfy business needs and objectives
Create and maintain detailed business requirements documentation (BRD) including process maps, business process and data flow diagrams
Facilitate meetings and workshops to elicit and refine requirements and drive consensus among stakeholders.
Assist in all phases of the SDLC
Actively support all stages of the Agile Scrum framework, including ideation, planning, implementation, testing, review and retrospective analysis
Actively support the flow of business requests through Project Management and service desk platforms
Support User Acceptance Testing for system releases
Work closely with technical teams (engineering, design, QA) to ensure that solutions meet business needs and are delivered on time and that all technical documentation is created and stored appropriately
Assist the PM and PO in the development and implementation of project plans and roadmaps, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables
Quickly learn and understand functionalities of business applications to assess feasibility of requirements and provide informed recommendations
Create, organize, and maintain Jira tickets with detailed descriptions and acceptance criteria, ensuring all work items are clearly defined and prioritized.
Manage and track multiple projects and balance competing priorities to meet tight deadlines.
Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams
Identify operational issues and propose new workflows/streams, application solutions, and process improvements for business units

Experience & Requirements

3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting technical project teams in the definition and delivery of business-critical systems
Experience in Agile & Waterfall project methodologies and Altassian products such as Jira and Confluence is required
Strong knowledge of SDLC
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical teams
Strong critical thinking, analytical, problem-solving skills and ability to think outside-of-the-box when assessing possible solutions
Expertise in eliciting and documenting business requirements through use cases, user stories, and other means (including workflow diagrams, dataflow diagrams, screen wireframes, etc)
Expertise with Microsoft tools such as Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint or other diagramming tools such as Lucidchart
Experience in development and execution of Test Cases and test management
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team
Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies in a fast-paced environment
High degree of flexibility, organization, and multi-tasking skills
Excellent decision-making skills and judgment
Strong customer service attitude, customer focused, aware of the importance of end-user satisfaction
Ability to approach problems with a sense of ownership, enthusiasm and innovation
Familiarity with nonprofit sector is a plus
Working proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience delivering solutions in a data visualization tool such as Tableau or Power BI required
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience balancing competing priorities, diverse stakeholder groups and varying levels of data fluency and technical skills
Familiarity with nonprofit or mission-driven operational models, fundraising principles and data environments, including experience navigating sensitive constituent data and federated data domains
Experience with data from CRM, fundraising and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Luminate Online, Marketing Cloud) a plus
Experience with Project Management and Service Desk platforms preferred

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field (required)
IIBA certification (ECBA, CCBA, or CBAP) or equivalent applied experience is preferred

jobs.title: Revenue Integrity Analyst
jobs.description:
SPHS-Finance Administration

The Revenue Integrity Analyst will:

Own the accuracy and integrity of the Epic charge description master, including charge codes, descriptions, CPT/HCPCS assignment, revenue codes, modifiers, units of service, and effective dating. Maintain fee schedule groups and pricing records; ensure price changes are applied to the correct entities. Maintain charge routing rules, charge triggers, and order-entry linkage.
Identify and pursue missing charges through late charge analysis, revenue and usage variance review, and department reconciliation exception reporting. Analyze reimbursement variances where the root cause is charge or CDM related. Monitor high-risk charging areas on a defined cadence for high-dollar areas.
Develop and deliver role-based charge capture and reconciliation training for all end-users. Serve as first-line consultant to clinical departments on how a new service, order, supply, or drug should be built, charged, and reconciled.
Perform routine charge audits validating that services provided are documented, charged, coded, billed, and reimbursed correctly and consistently. Performs any other audits as requested.
Lead the annual pricing update process in partnership with Finance and Managed Care, including modeling of price change impact by payer, service line, and volume.
Serve as operational lead to the Financial Integrity Committee. Ensure that build decisions are coordinated amongst all parties. Maintain a centralized log of CDM requests.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in health information management, healthcare administration, finance, business, nursing, or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be substituted.
Minimum five (5) years of hospital revenue cycle experience with direct chargemaster, revenue integrity, or hospital billing responsibility.
Demonstrated working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, UB-04 claim structure, NCCI and MUE edits, and OPPS/APC methodology.
Demonstrated ability to analyze charge, revenue, and reimbursement data and to communicate findings to both clinical and financial audiences.
Demonstrated experience training or advising non-financial clinical staff on charge capture.
Strong Excel skills; ability to work with large charge and claim data extracts.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The Business Operations team sits within Finance and partners across Chainalysis to strengthen how the company plans, makes decisions, and executes. Combining analytical rigor with practical operating judgment, the team helps leaders translate company priorities into clear plans, effective operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. As Chainalysis continues to evolve, Business Operations also helps build the processes and ways of working that enable teams to scale and adapt.

You’ll join a close-knit team working with partners across Finance, R&D, go-to-market, Legal, Security, and beyond. The team takes on high-priority work across the business, often creating structure where approaches are still taking shape, and helps teams align and move change forward. This role offers broad exposure to Chainalysis and the opportunity to help shape how the company operates through its next stage of growth.

In this role, you’ll:

As a Senior Business Operations Analyst at Chainalysis, you will be a strategic operator and connective tissue across leadership and functions - helping translate company priorities into clear plans, operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. You’ll partner with leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to improve how the business plans, makes decisions, and executes.

You’ll support high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end: framing ambiguous problems, developing analyses and recommendations, aligning stakeholders, establishing milestones and governance, and driving follow-through. You’ll help run planning and business review cadences, build KPI reporting and insights, improve processes and systems, and support change initiatives such as pricing and packaging, go-to-market readiness, product launches, and organizational or operating-model changes.

You will also:

Identify friction in cross-functional workflows and design scalable processes, tools, and operating mechanisms.
Prepare clear, data-informed recommendations and executive-ready materials.
Manage multiple work-streams and facilitate alignment across stakeholders, balancing speed, rigor, and effective change management.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

3–6 years of experience in business operations, strategy and operations, management consulting, finance, program management, or a related field—ideally in a SaaS or technology environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready narratives and materials.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes.
Strong project and program management skills, including prioritization, stakeholder management, and attention to detail.
Familiarity with business intelligence, data, and collaboration tools; experience with Jira, Confluence, Databricks, spreadsheets, SQL, and/or AI-powered tools is a plus.
Ability to drive clarity in ambiguity, influence without authority, and demonstrate resilience in a dynamic environment.
Curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and make the company and team better.

Nice to have experience:

Business Operations or Strategy & Operations experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
Supporting annual or quarterly planning, operating cadences, business reviews, resource allocation, or strategic planning processes.
Establishing KPIs, building performance dashboards, and using data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Supporting pricing and packaging, go-to-market or commercialization initiatives, product launches, or broader change-management efforts.
Applying agile, lean, or other process-improvement methodologies to scale how teams work.
Interest in and general knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency, including key players and market dynamics.

AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.description:
Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst

ROLE OVERVIEW: Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst

The Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst
will develop data-driven material forecasts and inventory plans across a complex global operating network. This role translates demand, consumption, lead-time, and inventory data into practical recommendations that keep production and repair facilities supplied while protecting working capital.

Reporting to the Head of Global Supply Chain, this individual will partner with Supply Chain, Asset Management, Finance, Distribution, and operating sites to consolidate material requirements and evaluate inventory positioning. The successful candidate will own analytical models, challenge planning assumptions, anticipate shortages and excess inventory, and deliver clear, decision-ready recommendations. Success requires advanced analytical capability, operational judgment, and proactive ownership.

RESPONSIBILITIES: Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst

Build and maintain material-demand forecasts using consumption, repair orders, operating plans, lead times, and site requirements.
Analyze inventory coverage, material velocity, and supply risk to recommend where and when stock should be positioned.
Develop advanced Excel and scenario models to assess changing demand, shortages, excess inventory, and replenishment options.
Partner with operating sites and supply chain teams to validate demand signals, improve data quality, and standardize planning assumptions.
Translate complex supply chain and financial data into clear recommendations for leadership on inventory investment and material availability.
Analyze logistics and distribution costs, forecast variances, and supply chain KPIs to support capital-efficient decisions.
Use enterprise reporting and analytical tools, including appropriate AI-enabled capabilities, to improve forecasting and planning processes.

REQUIREMENTS: Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst

5+ years of experience in supply chain analytics, operations analysis, FP&A, or related quantitative work, including ownership of complex analytical models.
Advanced Excel and financial modeling expertise, with demonstrated skill in forecasting, scenario planning, and communicating findings.
Ability to analyze demand, consumption, inventory, lead times, and material requirements across multiple sites or business units.
Experience translating complex data into actionable recommendations and challenging assumptions with sound business judgment.
Proficiency with ERP data and analytical platforms; experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or Palantir is beneficial.
Strong ownership, independent problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills; bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

COMPENSATION: Global Supply Chain Senior Analyst

A meaningful compensation package will be developed for the successful candidate that includes a base salary plus performance-based bonus.

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Sailor has exceptional product-market fit:

Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.
AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.
Talent-dense team: We are a 25-person team in our NYC office and are backed by the founders of Ramp, Nourish, Headway, Charlie Health, and Spring Health.

⭐
About the Role

We’re hiring our first
Founding Data & Analytics Engineer to architect and scale Sailor’s data foundation, powering everything from clinical insights to AI copilots. You’ll work closely with our co-founders, clinicians, and engineers to build the pipelines and analytics that fuel care delivery and decision-making.

This is a ground-floor opportunity to build an AI-first data stack from scratch at a startup with extreme PMF. You’ll design the data models that measure patient outcomes, automate operations, and unlock intelligence across our platform.

We're honestly looking for a bit of a unicorn
: someone who can architect pipelines like a data engineer, ship web apps like a product engineer, and reason about the business like a founder.

💻 What You’ll Do

Create data-powered web apps to solve tangible business problems
Build pipelines in Snowflake and dbt that unify data from EHR, CRM, and communication systems
Develop AI and ML-driven analyses of therapy transcripts and patient data
Automate backend operations with Python scripts that power clinical and billing workflows
Track and visualize clinical outcomes (PHQ-9, GAD-7, etc.)
Collaborate cross-functionally with clinicians and founders to turn data into action
Build long-term horizon data architectures and solutions that grow as our user base and internal teams grow

✅ You’re a Great Fit If You

Live in NYC and energized by in-person work
Have 3-10 years of experience in data engineering or analytics
Are fluent in SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake
Have experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, and unstructured data (e.g., transcripts, FHIR format)
Bring high EQ and can communicate clearly with non-technical teammates
Move fast, set a high bar, and care deeply about improving mental health for older adults

✚ Our Offer to You

💰 Top quartile salary and equity
🩺 Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental & vision insurance
🌴 Flexible PTO and sick days
🍱 Lunch and dinner in our beautiful Soho office covered by Sailor
🎤 Team building events
🕺🏻 Friendliest and most dynamic team culture
✚ Additional: One Medical Membership for US employees, HSA, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teladoc Health

💙 Our Values

💙 Make your Grandparents Proud: Remember why you’re here and build the standard of care you wish your grandparents received.
💡 Best Ideas Win: We strip problems down to first principles and challenge each other – but once a decision is made, we row as one.
⚡️Go Fast and Far: We have a burning sense of urgency AND we go the extra mile.
🥇 Do What It Takes To Be #1: We obsess over excellence and challenge ourselves and each other to actualize our best selves.
⛵ Happy Crew: A miserable crew rows slow. A happy crew rows fast. Fun is a performance metric.

Compensation Range: $150K - $300K

Job Description

Director, Marketing Operations at Hearst Newspapers

About The Role

Hearst Newspapers is looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Marketing Operations to lead the technology, processes, and team supporting our digital subscription marketing business.

Reporting to the VP of Digital Subscriptions, this role leads a team of four and serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.

A major focus of the role is email and newsletter optimization- ensuring our customer communications, lifecycle programs, audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation are effective, scalable, and continuously improving.

This person will also help manage and evolve the MarTech ecosystem supporting our digital subscriber journey, from audience and customer data through website experiences, offers, checkout, and ongoing subscriber communications.

This is not primarily a campaign execution, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, or project management role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technology behind modern marketing and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

What You’ll Do

Lead and develop a team of four Marketing Operations professionals.
Own and continuously improve the technology and operational processes supporting email, newsletters, lifecycle marketing, CRM/CDP, and marketing automation.
Partner with Marketing and Editorial to improve the performance, personalization, segmentation, and effectiveness of email and newsletter programs.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into technical requirements and deliver new capabilities.
Help oversee the technology supporting the digital customer journey, including websites, audience data, personalization, subscription offers, and customer communications.
Diagnose and troubleshoot issues across platforms, data flows, integrations, campaigns, and customer experiences.
Establish effective intake, prioritization, QA, governance, and release processes across multiple Hearst newspaper markets.
Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and enable Marketing teams to do more.
Evaluate vendors and technology solutions and help ensure the MarTech ecosystem is scalable and well integrated.
Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, BI, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.
Create processes and capabilities that can scale consistently across Hearst Newspapers’ markets while still supporting local needs.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

Significant experience in Marketing Operations, preferably leading a Marketing Operations function or team.
Deep, hands-on experience with email and/or newsletter operations, including segmentation, lifecycle communications, personalization, QA, testing, and optimization.
Strong knowledge of MarTech platforms, marketing automation, CRM/CDP, and customer data.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build or improve marketing capabilities.
Strong understanding of how data moves across marketing systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.
Experience managing and prioritizing competing requests across multiple stakeholders or business units.
Proven people leadership experience.
Strong business judgment and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions.
Experience using AI and automation to improve marketing processes and team efficiency.

Preferred:

Experience in media, publishing, subscriptions, or consumer marketing.
Experience supporting multiple brands, markets, or decentralized organizations.
Experience with website/digital customer experiences, personalization, subscription offers, or checkout.
Experience with platforms such as BlueConic, Sailthru, Salesforce, or comparable MarTech solutions.
Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, or data activation.
Experience evaluating vendors and implementing new marketing capabilities.

The Person We’re Looking For

You’re someone who enjoys figuring out how things work and how to make them work better.

You don’t simply take a request and pass it along to Engineering. You ask questions, understand the underlying business and technical problem, identify the right solution, and bring the right teams together to make it happen.

You’re comfortable moving between marketing strategy, technology, data, and operations, and you know when to get into the details and when to step back and lead.

You’re curious about AI, constantly looking for ways to eliminate manual work, and comfortable operating in a complex, multi-market organization where priorities don’t always align.

Our Benefits:
At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family). Our industry-leading benefits include:

Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Director, Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational strategy, execution, reliability, and advancement of the platforms and processes that power Hearst Newspapers' digital subscription marketing strategy. This role leads day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, subscription rates and offers, data integrations, and platform quality assurance, ensuring the marketing technology stack operates reliably while continually improving how Marketing uses technology, data, AI, and automation. This is a centralized role supporting nine markets, with responsibility for building consistent, scalable processes and capabilities across the portfolio.

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent marketing operations leader who combines deep hands-on marketing technology experience, strong data and systems thinking, and disciplined operational leadership. This person will manage a distributed team of four and serve as a key bridge between Marketing and Product, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, Customer Service, and technology vendors - translating marketing needs into clear requirements, identifying new capabilities and opportunities, and driving adoption across marketing and newsrooms.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team, managing workload, performance, priorities, and professional development while establishing clear ownership, service levels, operating rhythms, and accountability.
Own the Marketing Operations intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, allocating team capacity, managing tradeoffs, and keeping stakeholders aligned on timing, scope, and dependencies.
Own day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, and any other future platforms, including platform administration, workflows, audience segmentation, campaign activation, personalization, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and scalable execution across markets, with particular responsibility for supporting Marketing and newsroom teams in their use of Sailthru.
Ensure operational reliability across recurring marketing processes, integrations, audience and data flows, rates and offers, tracking, and platform capabilities; proactively monitor for issues, diagnose root causes across systems, and partner with BI, Product, and vendors on resolution and safeguards.
Oversee email operations across newsletters, lead generation, acquisition, retention, and other lifecycle communications, including audience selection, campaign/template setup, scheduling, suppression logic, deployment, and operational readiness. Partner closely with marketing and newsroom teams to strengthen newsletter capabilities, workflows, and best practices.
Manage the operational setup and governance of checkout and cancellation flows, subscription rates, pricing configurations, and promotional offers, partnering with Finance, Marketing, Product, and Customer Service to ensure accurate implementation across customer experiences.
Serve as Marketing's close partner to the Product Director and as the primary Marketing-to-technology translator: turn loosely defined business problems and ideas into clear functional, data, and operational requirements; support prioritization, ideation, implementation, testing, and rollout; and translate technical capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs into practical marketing implications and opportunities.
Proactively identify opportunities to expand Marketing's capabilities through existing or new technology, data, AI, automation, and self-service. Assess business value and operational feasibility, reduce manual work and handoffs, enable appropriate self-service, and move the strongest opportunities from concept to implementation while maintaining governance and human oversight.
Manage marketing technology vendors, including relationships, contracts, renewals, platform performance, issue resolution, roadmap alignment, and service levels. In partnership with Product and technical stakeholders, represent Marketing in evaluating prospective technology and assessing capabilities, gaps, integration needs, and tradeoffs against business requirements.
Lead capability rollout and adoption across Marketing and newsrooms by translating new functionality into usable workflows, documentation, training, governance, and operating practices; establish rigorous QA and change-management standards to ensure capabilities are implemented accurately and sustainably.

Strong hands-on experience directly configuring and troubleshooting marketing technology platforms, including customer data platforms, email/CRM platforms, audience segmentation, automation, personalization, business rules, and campaign activation; BlueConic and Sailthru experience are strongly preferred.
Strong technical fluency across marketing technology ecosystems, including data integrations, APIs and data feeds, audience schemas, identity and profile data, tracking, campaign logic, platform dependencies, and data flows between marketing platforms and enterprise data environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose marketing technology and data issues, trace problems across systems and data flows, identify likely root causes, and partner effectively with BI, Product, Engineering, and vendors on resolution.
Strong data and systems literacy, including the ability to interpret data schemas, understand field-level logic and transformations, validate outputs, translate business needs into precise technical and data requirements, and assess upstream and downstream dependencies; familiarity with SQL or similar data-querying concepts is strongly preferred.
Strong experience with email and newsletter operations, including supporting both Marketing and newsroom use cases, segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, automation, deployment workflows, deliverability considerations, and identifying and implementing new platform capabilities and best practice.
Experience managing checkout or monetization platforms, subscription pricing, rates, promotional offers, or comparable configuration-driven customer subscription programs.
Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, partner effectively with Product and technical teams, evaluate technology capabilities and tradeoffs, and drive adoption of new tools and functionality across non-technical users.

Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, and self-service approaches to improve operational workflows, QA, speed, and team capacity while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.
Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving and operational judgment, and the ability to balance business urgency with platform integrity, data quality, scalability, and sustainable processes in a fast-moving environment.

The Contract Administration Section oversees the processing of all procurements for the NYPD to meet the needs of the Department. The purchases overseen by the Contract Administration Section include the following types of contracts: (1) Construction related procurements, such as renovations and repairs of NYPD facilities, as well as contracts for scaffolding, and parking lot and sidewalk resurfacing, (2) plant management, including various contracts for maintaining various building systems and equipment, (3) a variety of contracts to meet the Department's various Information Technology needs, including software, hardware, maintaining and enhancing various Department Systems, and special projects such as the implementation of a Gunshot Detection System and a Body Camera System; (4) various emergency contracts to take care of needs of the Department that come up on an emergency basis, and (5) contracts for specialized goods and services such as helicopters, firearms, horses, and bullet proof vests. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us:

At Botrista, we are revolutionizing beverage culture with intuitive, Nature-guided drink-making technology. By empowering restaurants and establishments to expand their menus without added complexity, we are driving growth and innovation at the touch of a button. Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our solutions create a new industry category, applicable to any cuisine, demographic, and business. With rapid deployment of our machines nationwide, we are delivering extraordinary beverage experiences to customers everywhere.

Position Summary

Botrista is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Revenue Operations Analyst to help us better understand what drives revenue growth, customer performance, retention, and profitability across the business.

Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, this role will serve as a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance. The Revenue Analyst will connect data across Sales, Account Management, customer performance, deployments, operations, and financial results to identify trends, explain performance, uncover opportunities and risks, and support better business decisions.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable digging into complex data, and able to move beyond what happened to understand why it happened and what we should do about it.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with commercial judgment and can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Performance & Business Analysis

Analyze revenue performance against plan and identify the underlying drivers of variances
Evaluate new customer revenue, recurring ingredient revenue, same-store performance, customer retention, expansion, cups sold daily (CSD), deployments, and other key revenue drivers
Develop cohort and segmentation analyses across verticals, customer types, sales channels, territories, deal structures, acquisition sources, and other relevant dimensions
Identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they become obvious in topline results
Partner with Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance to develop a consistent view of commercial and financial performance
Translate analysis into clear recommendations and business actions

Sales Analytics

Analyze pipeline health, coverage, conversion, sales velocity, win/loss performance, quota attainment, and seller productivity
Evaluate lead sources, territories, customer segments, ICP performance, and sales motions
Support analysis of sales capacity, territory design, quotas, and resource allocation
Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion
Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base
Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk
Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance
Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion
Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring
Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale → Deployment → Live → Productive → Recurring Revenue → Retention → Expansion

Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments
Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis
Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value
Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting
Build and maintain analytical models for revenue growth, customer performance, capacity, retention, and other business drivers
Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis
Evaluate the expected impact of changes in headcount, productivity, pricing, customer mix, retention, CSD, deployment timing, and other key assumptions
Perform sensitivity analyses to help leadership understand the range of potential business outcomes

Reporting & Business Reviews

Build and maintain core Sales, Account Management, and revenue performance reporting
Support weekly and monthly business reviews with analysis of key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities
Maintain consistent metric definitions and help establish a trusted source of truth across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance
Improve existing reporting by eliminating low-value metrics and introducing measures that better reflect business performance
Automate recurring analysis and reporting wherever practical

Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support leadership with analytical work on high-priority business questions, including:

Which customer segments and verticals generate the greatest long-term value?
What predicts high CSD, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion?
Where are we losing revenue and why?
Which sales motions and acquisition sources produce the highest-quality customers?
Where should we add or reduce Sales and Account Management resources?
Which programs and initiatives are generating measurable incremental value?
Where are operational bottlenecks limiting revenue?
Which parts of the business should we scale, improve, or reconsider?
What are we not currently measuring that could materially change how we operate?

Cross-Functional Operating Model

The Revenue Analyst will be a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.

The role reports to the Revenue Operations Manager, who will help prioritize the analyst's overall workload and ensure analytical work translates into commercial action. However, the analyst will work directly and regularly with Commercial Planning and Finance and will support important analytical and planning needs across all three functions.

Success requires operating as part of one analytical ecosystem rather than three separate teams. The expectation is to create shared definitions, shared data, and a common understanding of business performance while bringing the appropriate functional perspective to each analysis.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Revenue Analyst will:

Surface insights leadership did not already know
Explain the drivers behind business performance rather than simply reporting results
Identify revenue opportunities and risks early enough for the organization to act
Improve confidence in the metrics used to run the business
Connect Sales and operational activity to actual customer and financial outcomes
Reduce manual reporting and increase time spent on higher-value analysis
Help Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance operate from a consistent view of the business
Develop a deep enough understanding of Botrista's business model to independently identify questions worth investigating
Consistently move from data → insight → recommendation

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Finance, Strategy, Business Operations, or a related analytical role
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets
Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills
Experience with Salesforce data and CRM reporting strongly preferred
Experience with BI and data visualization tools preferred
Experience building financial, operational, forecasting, or scenario models
Strong understanding of business metrics and ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the larger business question
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and business questions evolve quickly

What We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in someone who:

Is intellectually curious and naturally asks "why?"
Enjoys finding patterns and anomalies in data
Does not stop at producing a dashboard or spreadsheet
Can distinguish correlation from meaningful business drivers
Is comfortable challenging assumptions when the data suggests something different
Can take an ambiguous business question and independently determine how to analyze it
Understands that perfect data is rarely available and can make thoughtful recommendations while clearly communicating assumptions and limitations
Wants their analysis to influence how a business actually operates

Benefits

Fully company-paid Medical and 99% company-paid Dental and Vision Insurance
Flex PTO, 7 sick days, 14 holidays, Wellness Benefits, Cell Phone and Internet reimbursement, 401K

Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000

Plus commissions and stock options

jobs.title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

About WPP

WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.

About The Role

The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.

Why This Role Matters

WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.

What You’ll Do

Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability

Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.
Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.
Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.
Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.
Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.

Enable strategic workforce planning

Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.
Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.
Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.
Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.

Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support

Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.
Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.
Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.
Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.

Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions

Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.
Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.
Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.
Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.

Scale tools, capability and adoption

Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.
Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.
Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.
Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.
Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.

Minimum Qualifications

Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.
Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.
Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.
Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.
AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.
Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.
A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.
Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.
Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.
Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.
A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.
Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.
Stronger adoption of workforce insight by business and People & Culture leaders, with greater confidence in what the data can and cannot support.
A focused, capable India-based team that delivers consistent reporting while building higher-value workforce intelligence and decision-support capability.

jobs.title: Marketing Analytics Lead, Enterprise Marketing
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Marketing Analytics Lead at Anthropic, you will own how we measure marketing. You'll build and run a single measurement framework that shows how marketing activity turns into pipeline, revenue, and product usage, and you'll make that framework something marketers and executives actually use to make decisions. As our marketing programs grow across enterprise and product-led motions, your work will determine whether we invest in what works.

In this role, you'll own the marketing measurement framework end to end: the metric definitions, the data models behind them, the dashboards that surface them, and the insights they produce. This is a hands-on individual contributor role; data science and data engineering will support you, but you'll do the core work yourself. You'll partner closely with field marketing, partner marketing, campaign marketing, finance, sales strategy, sales development, data science, and data engineering to align on definitions and keep the whole organization working from one view of the funnel.

Key responsibilities

Own the marketing measurement framework that connects marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and product usage
Set the direction for the framework and extend it to programs it doesn't cover yet
Define marketing metrics clearly and get cross-functional teams to agree on definitions early
Build and maintain the data models that power marketing reporting
Develop dashboards that marketers and executives rely on in their weekly reviews
Teach marketers and executives how the metrics work, and keep teaching as the metrics evolve
Lead adoption of the framework so that both marketing and executive teams use it as their shared source of truth
Partner with finance, sales strategy, and sales development to connect marketing measurement to the broader revenue picture
Find and share the insights nobody asked for, turning analysis into recommendations that change what we do
Write analytical SQL on large datasets to answer questions about funnel performance and attribution
Track framework gaps and data quality issues, and work with data engineering to resolve them
Present findings to marketing leadership and executives in clear, decision-ready formats

Minimum Qualifications

Have deep experience with marketing analytics, including lead funnels, attribution to enterprise pipeline, and product usage measurement
Have designed metrics from scratch and know what makes a metric trusted and useful
Can write analytical SQL on large datasets with confidence
Have built data models in tools like dbt and dashboards that many people use daily
Are comfortable setting direction without waiting for a plan to be handed to you
Can turn vague questions into clear, measurable definitions
Work well across functions and know how to get teams aligned on definitions before problems surface
Enjoy teaching others how metrics work and helping non-technical audiences build data fluency
Finish what you start, from first definition to adopted dashboard
Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building marketing measurement for both enterprise sales-led and product-led growth motions
Familiarity with marketing attribution models and their practical tradeoffs
Experience presenting metrics and insights directly to executives and shaping how leadership reviews performance
A background in data science, analytics engineering, or marketing operations
Experience working with CRM and marketing automation data, such as Salesforce and related tooling
Experience standing up a measurement practice where one didn't exist before
Familiarity with how finance and sales strategy teams think about pipeline and forecasting

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$255,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

Experience moving existing customers onto new pricing, including migrations, grandfathering and amendments at scale
Experience with tax setup for new products (tax codes, tax engines such as Anrok or Avalara)
Experience with integrations between Salesforce and billing, ERP or provisioning systems, and comfort reading API payloads and integration logs

The Business Operations team sits within Finance and partners across Chainalysis to strengthen how the company plans, makes decisions, and executes. Combining analytical rigor with practical operating judgment, the team helps leaders translate company priorities into clear plans, effective operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. As Chainalysis continues to evolve, Business Operations also helps build the processes and ways of working that enable teams to scale and adapt.

You’ll join a close-knit team working with partners across Finance, R&D, go-to-market, Legal, Security, and beyond. The team takes on high-priority work across the business, often creating structure where approaches are still taking shape, and helps teams align and move change forward. This role offers broad exposure to Chainalysis and the opportunity to help shape how the company operates through its next stage of growth.

In this role, you’ll:

As a Senior Business Operations Analyst at Chainalysis, you will be a strategic operator and connective tissue across leadership and functions - helping translate company priorities into clear plans, operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. You’ll partner with leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to improve how the business plans, makes decisions, and executes.

You’ll support high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end: framing ambiguous problems, developing analyses and recommendations, aligning stakeholders, establishing milestones and governance, and driving follow-through. You’ll help run planning and business review cadences, build KPI reporting and insights, improve processes and systems, and support change initiatives such as pricing and packaging, go-to-market readiness, product launches, and organizational or operating-model changes.

Identify friction in cross-functional workflows and design scalable processes, tools, and operating mechanisms.
Prepare clear, data-informed recommendations and executive-ready materials.
Manage multiple work-streams and facilitate alignment across stakeholders, balancing speed, rigor, and effective change management.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready narratives and materials.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes.
Strong project and program management skills, including prioritization, stakeholder management, and attention to detail.

Curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and make the company and team better.

Business Operations or Strategy & Operations experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

Supporting pricing and packaging, go-to-market or commercialization initiatives, product launches, or broader change-management efforts.
Applying agile, lean, or other process-improvement methodologies to scale how teams work.
Interest in and general knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency, including key players and market dynamics.

AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. QA & Integrations Analyst

Location is NYC 17
th
street 

RETAIL/APPAREL OR HOMEGOODS EXP IS A MUST

Overview:

The QA and Integrations Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability and accuracy of integrations between Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) systems. This position is responsible for the development and execution of test cases for integration points, validation of data flows, documentation of processes, and support during system deployments and upgrades. The analyst partners with cross-functional teams such as IT, business analysts, developers, and end users to guarantee that business requirements are met through robust technical solutions and effective quality assurance practices.

The role requires effective communication, teamwork, and adaptability in a dynamic environment where priorities may shift with project demands. Participation in cross-functional projects and meetings is essential to ensure seamless integration and quality assurance outcomes.

Responsibilities:

Support and validate integrations between ERP and DTC platforms, including but not limited to Shopify, NewStore, and Exenta.
Understand and apply data transformation and information mapping concepts to ensure data integrity across integrated systems.
Develop, maintain, and execute test cases and test scripts for system integrations, focusing on functionality, accuracy, and reliability.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to clarify integration requirements and expected outcomes.
Provide deployment support by partnering with cross-functional teams during system rollouts, updates, and platform upgrades.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including test cases, test results, issue logs, and deployment procedures.
Participate in broader projects such as system upgrades and new integrations, contributing technical validation and system testing expertise.
Identify, create, and manage test data across multiple systems to support comprehensive testing scenarios.
Contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, working with users and developers to resolve bugs and defects promptly.
Participate in regression testing and support automation initiatives to ensure ongoing system stability.
Create clear and user-friendly documentation for users, workflows, and technical processes related to integrations and QA activities.

﻿
Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in equivalent professional experience.
Strong understanding of system integration concepts, data transformation, and information mapping.
Hands-on experience developing and executing test cases and scripts for system integrations.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficiency in documenting test procedures, results, and technical workflows clearly and accurately.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

Experience working with ERP, DTC, and retail systems, particularly Shopify, NewStore, and Exenta.
Familiarity with software quality assurance methodologies, user acceptance testing, and regression testing.
Exposure to project-based work involving system integrations and platform upgrades.
Experience with test automation tools and practices is a plus.

Our second brand, RE:YOU (getreyou.com), is dominating the luxury haircare market and is already one of the fastest growing brands ever after launching in July 2026.

We are a venture-funded startup and founded by experienced entrepreneurs who have built and sold nine-figure businesses before. We are backed by some of the best venture firms in the world (Maveron, Khosla Ventures, Mars, Imaginary Ventures) and are building a world-class team together to transform the consumer health industry as we know it.

You’ll have the opportunity to help scale our organic and paid advertisements channels and partnerships. You’ll assist with the development of Pacagen and RE:YOU’s creative content across all channels and website iteration. The best candidate will have a proven track record for clear communication and proactive problem-solving. You will be mentored by and working directly with our co-founders who built and sold one of the fastest-growing science-backed beauty brands ever. This role is for someone who actively enjoys working in a fast-paced environment while taking on larger responsibilities within a rapidly growing organization.

Responsibilities:
● Work with the rest of the team to brainstorm and develop new, creative approaches for advertising that meet Pacagen and RE:YOU’s objectives and goals.
● Oversee development of video content and ads for all Pacagen and RE:YOU’s paid channels using best practices for each platform, including Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, and Youtube.
● Manage large influencer collaborations.
● Proactively stay on top of trends/best practices for social video platforms and develop new creative ideas and approaches.
● Create, edit, and resize video & still ads for different platforms as needed.
● Communicate with the entire team on different creative needs.
● Present ideas on creative strategy and campaigns.

Requirements:
● BS or BA in any field. But a proven track-record of high performance.
● Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Or the willingness to learn them quickly.
● Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom).
● Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
● Track record of high-quality work.
● Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
● Clear communication skills.
● Ability to multitask and adhere to deadlines.
● Doesn’t take good enough for an answer.
● Constantly trying to improve themselves.

Why work with us?

We’re a fast-paced startup that is delivering life-changing products. We have products that you can believe in and a team that works hard to make sure that we can get those products into the hands of the people that need them most. Working at Pacagen will be an exciting growth opportunity for your career. You’ll get exposure to world-class partners, mentors, and innovative people from every field.

Why NOT work with us?

You’ll notice that the phrase “fast-paced” is in this job description multiple times. America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.
AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.

Build long-term horizon data architectures and solutions that grow as our user base and internal teams grow
